Explore India's Biggest Kitchen at Takht Sri Patna Sahib Gurudwara, the sacred birthplace of Guru Gobind Singh Ji. Join Veggie Paaji on an incredible langar tour in Patna, Bihar!
Witness the miracle of how a small team of just 10-12 people prepares langar (community meal) for over 25,000 devotees every single day. This mega kitchen runs 22 hours daily, showcasing a blend of unwavering faith and amazing modern technology.
In this video, we take you behind the scenes to see:
The massive, modern machines that cook 200 KGs of daal in just one hour.
